source_caption:
Upgrade (2018) is a sci-fi action thriller following Grey Trace, a mechanic whose life is destroyed after a brutal attack leaves him paralyzed and his wife dead. Once independent and physically capable, Grey is suddenly trapped inside his own body, unable to move without assistance.
Everything changes when he is offered an experimental computer implant called STEM. The advanced technology gives Grey control over his body again, dramatically improving his strength, speed, reflexes, and physical abilities. At first, the implant seems like the chance to reclaim the life he lost.
But STEM is far more than a simple medical device. As Grey begins investigating the people responsible for the attack, he discovers that the technology inside him has its own capabilities and intentions. The more he relies on STEM, the more he must question who is truly in control of his body.
His search for answers takes him into a world of advanced technology, corporate secrets, violence, and artificial intelligence. Every discovery brings him closer to the truth while forcing him to confront the frightening consequences of giving a machine access to the human mind and body.
The film explores themes of revenge, identity, technology, free will, control, and the relationship between humans and artificial intelligence. Grey's transformation raises a deeper question: if technology can give someone back everything they lost, what happens when the technology starts making decisions for them?
What makes Upgrade stand out is the combination of brutal action and its technological mystery. Grey may have regained his ability to fight, but every victory comes with a growing uncertainty about how much control he actually has.
More than just a futuristic action movie, Upgrade is a story about a man searching for justice while slowly discovering that the greatest threat may not be outside his body—but inside it.
💬 If a machine could make you stronger, faster, and almost unstoppable, would you trust it with complete control of your body?

source_details.synopsis: Upgrade is a 2018 action thriller film written and directed by Leigh Whannell, and starring Logan Marshall-Green, Betty Gabriel, and Harrison Gilbertson. Upgrade follows a technophobe who is implanted with a chip that allows him to control his body after a mugging left him paralyzed. The cyberpunk film was produced by Jason Blum, under his Blumhouse Productions banner. After premiering on 10 March 2018 at South by Southwest, Upgrade was released on 1 June 2018 in the United States by OTL Releasing and Blumhouse Tilt, and on 14 June in Australia.
